papers.summary: An external reuse layer for recursive agents that retrieves related grounding experience for an atomic subtask, binds action templates to the current objects and admissible actions, and lets a small frozen selector pick a bound action or defer to the original agent.
papers.summary_zh: 为递归式 agent 增加的外部复用层：对原子子任务检索相关的动作落地经验，把动作模板绑定到当前对象和可执行动作上，再由一个冻结的小型选择器选定动作或交回原 agent 处理。

papers.name: SkillRep
papers.title: SkillRep: Characterizing and Understanding the Representation Design Space of Agent Skill Retrieval
papers.summary: Studies the representation design space of skill retrieval by combining encoder fine-tuning, query- and document-side expansion, background projection, and a lexical channel in one retriever, and measures the request–skill gap to explain how these choices interact; builds a large skill pool from public registries.
papers.summary_zh: 把编码器微调、查询端与文档端扩展、背景投影和词汇通道组合进同一个检索器，系统研究 skill 检索的表示设计空间，并通过度量请求与 skill 之间的差距解释这些选择如何相互作用；另从公开注册表构建了大规模 skill 池。

papers.name: Beyond Gain
papers.title: Beyond Gain: Measuring Skill Internalization for Agent Skill Retirement
papers.summary: Argues that retiring a skill on with/without gain alone confuses internalized skills with ones no model can use, and instead withholds the skill, scores the model on a task synthesized from it, and trusts a high unaided score only when another model benefits from the skill; releases skills with tasks and per-item scores.
papers.summary_zh: 指出只看有无 skill 的增益来决定退役，会把已被模型内化的 skill 与谁都用不上的 skill 混为一谈；改为撤掉 skill、在由它合成的任务上给模型打分，且只有当另一模型能从该 skill 获益时才采信高的无辅助分数，并发布了带任务和逐项得分的 skill 集。

papers.name: Skill Dreaming
papers.title: Skill Dreaming: Evolving Repository Skills through Pull Request Streams
papers.summary: Builds a repository-specific skill library from validated pull requests and keeps refining it as new PRs arrive, so that the skills guide coding agents in implementing features and maintaining tests and documentation in a PR–repository–skill co-evolution loop.
papers.summary_zh: 从已验证的 pull request 中提取可执行知识构建仓库专属的 skill 库，并随新 PR 持续更新，使 skill 指导编码 agent 实现功能、维护测试和文档，形成 PR、仓库与 skill 的共同演化循环。

papers.name: HSE
papers.title: Hierarchical Skill Evolution for Coding Agent
papers.summary: Distills procedural skills from coding trajectories through hierarchical evidence aggregation, from task-level evidence to repository-specific candidates to cross-repository skills, driven by an external writer–evaluator loop while the coding model stays frozen.
papers.summary_zh: 通过分层证据聚合从编码轨迹中提炼流程性 skill：从单条轨迹的任务级证据，到仓库内的候选 skill，再到跨仓库可迁移的 skill；由外部的撰写—评估循环驱动，编码模型保持冻结。

papers.name: Epistemic Parity
papers.title: Navigating Epistemic Parity in LLM Agents: A Benchmark for Cross-Source Conflict Resolution Between Memory and Procedural Skills
papers.summary: A benchmark of contradictions between episodic memory and SKILL.md-style procedural skills injected into the same context, with a four-way conflict taxonomy and deterministic checkers, measuring which source agents follow, how placement and an explicit precedence directive change this, and whether the conflict is disclosed.
papers.summary_zh: 一个评测情景记忆与 SKILL.md 式流程 skill 在同一上下文中相互矛盾时 agent 如何裁决的基准，给出四类冲突分类和确定性检查器，测量 agent 听从哪一方、注入位置和显式优先级指令如何影响结果，以及是否向用户披露冲突。

papers.name: BiPA
papers.title: Does Your Generalist Skill Optimizer Really Incentivize Agentic Tasks? Rethinking Skill Optimization via Bipartite Attribution
papers.summary: Re-examines generalist skill optimizers on long-horizon agentic tasks by replaying their acceptance rule on candidates identical to the seed to measure gains from selection alone, and by tracing extra input tokens to the behaviors that learned rules induce; derives principles for accepting and costing skill edits.
papers.summary_zh: 在长程 agent 任务上重新检验通用 skill 优化器：在与种子完全相同的候选上重放其接受规则，以度量仅由挑选带来的“增益”，并把额外输入 token 追溯到学到的规则所引发的行为；据此提出接受和计价 skill 编辑的原则。

papers.name: SkillOpt-Lite
papers.title: SkillOpt-Lite: Better and Faster Agent Self-evolution via One Line of Vibe
papers.summary: Frames skill optimization as zeroth-order optimization and derives a minimal pipeline from three principles (file-system-based trajectory exploration, consensus attribute mining, independent validation gating), integrated into production coding agents and extended to whole-harness optimization.
papers.summary_zh: 把 skill 优化表述为零阶优化，并由三条原则（基于文件系统的轨迹探索、共识属性挖掘、独立验证把关）推出一个最简流程；已集成进生产级编码 agent，并可推广到整个 harness 的优化。

papers.name: EvoAgentBench
papers.title: EvoAgentBench: Benchmarking Agent Self-Evolution via Ability Transfer
papers.summary: A benchmark for agent self-evolution through procedural transfer: it extracts trace-grounded abilities from executions, canonicalizes them into operational units, and links tasks that share procedures in domain ability graphs so that every test task has verified training-side support.
papers.summary_zh: 评测 agent 通过流程性迁移实现自进化的基准：从执行轨迹中提取有依据的“能力”，规范化为可操作单元，并用领域能力图连接共享流程的任务，保证每个测试任务都有经验证的训练侧支撑。

papers.name: SkillGen
papers.title: SkillGen: Verified Inference-Time Agent Skill Synthesis
papers.summary: A multi-agent framework that synthesizes a single auditable skill from a base agent's trajectories through contrastive induction over successes and failures, then refines it while treating the skill as an intervention whose repairs and regressions are measured on the same instances with and without it.
papers.summary_zh: 一个多 agent 框架，通过对成功和失败轨迹的对比归纳，从基础 agent 的轨迹中合成单个可审查的 skill，并在迭代打磨时把 skill 视为一种干预，在相同实例上对比有无 skill 来统计其修复与回退。

papers.name: GRASP
papers.title: GRASP: Gated Regression-Aware Skill Proposer for Self-Improving LLM Agents
papers.summary: Treats agent improvement as a sequence of edits to a bounded skill library and admits each candidate only if it yields a net gain on a balanced held-out probe under a hard regression budget; evaluated on FHIR-based clinical agent benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh: 把 agent 改进视为对有界 skill 库的一系列编辑，每个候选只有在平衡的留出探针集上带来净提升且不超过硬性回退预算时才被接纳；在基于 FHIR 的临床 agent 基准上评测。

papers.name: EvoPathBench
papers.title: Beyond Endpoint Performance: Process-Level Evaluation of Self-Evolving Agents
papers.summary: A process-level benchmark for artifact-level self-evolution that freezes evolving memories or skills at successive checkpoints and evaluates generalization to unseen tasks, retention after unrelated learning, and rule adaptation on held-out episodes built from public trading data.
papers.summary_zh: 面向工件级自进化的过程级基准：在连续检查点冻结不断演化的记忆或 skill，在基于公开交易数据构建的留出片段上评估对新任务的泛化、学习无关内容后的保持，以及对新证据的规则适应。

papers.name: reSolve
papers.title: Self-Evolving Skills via Surrogate-Guided Solve-and-Reproduce
papers.summary: A per-task, oracle-in-the-loop framework for self-evolving skills that separates interactive solving from a self-contained deliverable re-executed in a fresh container, adds a surrogate verifier without access to hidden tests, and runs verifier-guided beam search over a solution-construction graph.
papers.summary_zh: 逐任务、带 oracle 的 skill 自进化框架：把交互式求解与在全新容器中独立重跑的自包含交付物分开，加入一个看不到隐藏测试的替代验证器，并在解构造图上做验证器引导的束搜索。

papers.name: Branch2Skill
papers.title: Branch2Skill: Efficient Skill Evolution Through Reasoning Trees
papers.summary: Runs budgeted Monte Carlo tree search per task and compares an elite reasoning path with sibling branches sharing its prefixes, turning one reasoning tree into step-wise evidence about which patterns a skill should retain, revise, or avoid.
papers.summary_zh: 对每个任务在预算内做蒙特卡洛树搜索，把最优推理路径与共享前缀的兄弟分支对比，从一棵推理树中得到关于 skill 应保留、修改或避免哪些模式的逐步证据。

papers.name: WebDev-Skills-Bench
papers.title: Signal or Noise? A Benchmark Study of Agent Skills in Web Development
papers.summary: A controlled study of public web-development skills on Web-Bench projects with matched conditions, including a length-matched irrelevant skill and component ablations, to separate the effect of skill content from prompt length and to ask whether a skill should be injected at all.
papers.summary_zh: 在 Web-Bench 项目上对公开的 Web 开发 skill 做受控研究，设置包括等长无关 skill 和组件消融在内的匹配条件，以区分 skill 内容本身与提示长度的影响，并检验某个 skill 是否应该被注入。

papers.name: VaG
papers.title: When Self-Evolution Backfires: Pre-Commit Gating against Skill Contamination in LLM Agents
papers.summary: Shows that skills distilled from an agent's own trajectories can contaminate later skills once a defective one enters the context, and proposes pre-commit gating with three heterogeneous critics plus marginal-gain subset selection before skills reach the runtime context.
papers.summary_zh: 指出 agent 从自身轨迹提炼的 skill 一旦有缺陷的进入上下文，就会污染之后提炼的 skill；据此提出提交前把关：用三个异构评审逐条过滤，再按边际增益选子集，之后才放入运行时上下文。

papers.name: OpenSkill
papers.title: OpenSkill: Open-World Self-Evolution for LLM Agents
papers.summary: Open-world self-evolution in which an agent builds both skills and its own verification signals from documentation, repositories, and the web, refining the synthesized skills against self-built virtual tasks without target-task supervision.
papers.summary_zh: 开放世界自进化：agent 从文档、代码库和网络中同时构建 skill 和自己的验证信号，并在自建的虚拟任务上打磨合成的 skill，不使用目标任务的监督。

papers.name: SkillBoost
papers.title: Rethinking Self-Evolution: A Constrained Exploration-Exploitation Process for Mitigating Skill Overfitting
papers.summary: Casts skill self-evolution as constrained search under an exploration–exploitation trade-off: failures are localized to editable skill components, the LLM's prior knowledge generates diverse repair candidates, and a candidate is committed only if it improves performance within a regression bound.
papers.summary_zh: 把 skill 自进化看作探索与利用权衡下的受约束搜索：把失败定位到可编辑的 skill 组件，用 LLM 的先验知识生成多样的修复候选，只有在回退不超限的前提下提升性能才提交。

papers.name: Feedback Dynamics
papers.title: Rethinking Self-Evolving Agent Skills: Feedback Dynamics over Multiple Rounds
papers.summary: A controlled multi-round evaluation of self-evolving skill systems that fixes the executor, optimizer, validation rule, and round budget and varies only the feedback shown to the optimizer (successes and failures, failures only, or successes only).
papers.summary_zh: 对自进化 skill 系统做多轮受控评估：固定执行器、优化器、验证规则和轮数预算，只改变给优化器看的反馈（成功与失败、仅失败或仅成功）。

papers.name: VCE-Skill
papers.title: VCE-Skill: Enhancing Skill Self-Evolution with Version-Change Experience
papers.summary: Distills public skill version histories into structured version-change experience and fuses it with trajectory-derived proposals from a base evolver, using external evolution priors alongside task-grounded evidence.
papers.summary_zh: 把公开 skill 的版本变更历史提炼成结构化的版本变更经验，并与基础进化器从轨迹得到的修改建议融合，在利用外部进化先验的同时保留针对当前任务的证据。

papers.name: SkillDisCo
papers.title: SKILL-DISCO: Distilling and Compiling Agent Traces into Reusable Procedural Skills
papers.summary: Views successful traces in FSM-defined scenarios as paths in an unknown transition graph, distills reusable parameterized control-flow subgraphs from them, and compiles these into callable, executable, and verifiable procedural skills.
papers.summary_zh: 在由有限状态机定义的场景中，把成功轨迹看作未知转移图上的路径，从中提炼可复用的参数化控制流子图，并编译成可调用、可执行、可验证的流程性 skill。

papers.name: SkillReducer
papers.title: SkillReducer: Optimizing LLM Agent Skills for Token Efficiency
papers.summary: After an empirical study of inefficiencies in public skills, compresses routing descriptions (generating missing ones via adversarial delta debugging) and restructures skill bodies into core rules plus on-demand supplementary content, with faithfulness checks.
papers.summary_zh: 在对公开 skill 冗余问题做实证研究之后，压缩路由描述（缺失的用对抗式 delta debugging 生成），并把 skill 正文重组为核心规则加按需加载的补充内容，同时做忠实性检查。

papers.name: AFTER
papers.title: Managing Procedural Memory in LLM Agents: Control, Adaptation, and Evaluation
papers.summary: An enterprise benchmark across professional roles and procedural skills with controlled settings for local improvement, cross-task, cross-role, and cross-model transfer of skills held in an agent's procedural memory.
papers.summary_zh: 覆盖多个职业角色和流程 skill 的企业任务基准，设有本地改进、跨任务、跨角色和跨模型迁移等受控设置，用于评估 agent 程序性记忆中 skill 的复用与迁移。

papers.name: SkillSV
papers.title: What Is a Skill Worth? Structure-Aware Shapley Valuation of Agent Skills
papers.summary: Structure-aware Shapley-style valuation of the internal units of a fixed skill (rules, examples, scripts, heuristics) that respects dependencies and hierarchy, separates content value from context cost with paired deletion and length-neutral padding, and guides pruning and compression.
papers.summary_zh: 对固定 skill 的内部单元（规则、示例、脚本、启发式）做结构感知的类 Shapley 估值：尊重单元间的依赖与层级，用成对删除和长度中性填充区分内容价值与上下文开销，并用于指导剪枝和压缩。

papers.name: SkillComposer
papers.title: SkillComposer: Learning to Evolve Agent Skills for Specification and Generalization
papers.summary: Decomposes skill construction into learnable create, improve, and merge operations and trains a small model with rejection sampling to evolve skills at inference time for a separate executor, in offline, online, or hybrid modes.
papers.summary_zh: 把 skill 构建拆成可学习的创建、改进和合并三种操作，用拒绝采样训练一个小模型，在推理时为另一个执行模型演化 skill，支持离线、在线和混合三种部署方式。

papers.name: OPID
papers.title: OPID: On-Policy Skill Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: Extracts hierarchical episode- and step-level skills from completed on-policy trajectories, injects the routed skill into the history so the old policy re-scores the same response with and without it, and uses the log-probability shift as a token-level self-distillation advantage alongside the outcome reward.
papers.summary_zh: 从已完成的 on-policy 轨迹中提取回合级和步骤级的分层 skill，把路由选中的 skill 注入历史，让旧策略对同一回复在有无 skill 两种上下文下重新打分，以对数概率差作为 token 级自蒸馏优势，与结果奖励结合训练策略。

papers.name: CoEvoSkills
papers.title: CoEvoSkills: Self-Evolving Agent Skills via Co-Evolutionary Verification
papers.summary: Lets agents construct multi-file skill packages by coupling a skill generator that iteratively refines skills with a surrogate verifier that co-evolves to give actionable feedback without access to ground-truth tests.
papers.summary_zh: 让 agent 自主构建多文件 skill 包：迭代打磨 skill 的生成器与一个共同进化、在看不到真实测试的情况下给出可操作反馈的替代验证器相互配合。

papers.name: AdaSkill
papers.title: From Multi-Agent to Single-Agent: When Is Skill Distillation Beneficial?
papers.summary: Studies which components of a multi-agent workflow should survive when it is distilled into a single-agent skill, separating capability resources from pipeline guidance and using a pre-synthesis diagnostic to decide when to retain workflow guidance.
papers.summary_zh: 研究把多 agent 工作流蒸馏为单 agent skill 时哪些组件应该保留，区分能力资源与流程指导，并用合成前的诊断指标决定何时保留工作流指导。

papers.name: Mara Chain
papers.title: Mara Chain: Rethinking Failure as a Stepping Stone for AI System Auto-Evolution
papers.summary: Instead of discarding rejected candidates in propose–evaluate–select loops over skills, harnesses, and pipelines, keeps and iteratively refines them with evidence from earlier attempts under a bounded chain depth and Pareto-filtered top-N selection; includes AppWorld skill optimization.
papers.summary_zh: 在针对 skill、harness 和流水线的“提出—评估—选择”循环中不丢弃被拒候选，而是在限定链深度和 Pareto 过滤的 Top-N 选择下，用之前尝试积累的证据继续打磨它们；实验包括 AppWorld 上的 skill 优化。

papers.name: SkillHelix
papers.title: SkillHelix: Coevolving Agent Skills via Decision and Reasoning Synergy
papers.summary: Assigns credit to individual skill edits by pairing a black-box reasoning model with a small open-weight decision model whose likelihood of gold answers gives a dense signal, uses it to select and refine edits, and assigns Shapley credits that revise the optimizer skill so the two skills co-evolve.
papers.summary_zh: 把黑盒推理模型与一个小型开源决策模型配对，用后者对标准答案的似然变化为单个 skill 编辑分配功劳，据此挑选和润色编辑，并用 Shapley 值修订优化器 skill，使任务 skill 与优化器 skill 共同进化。

papers.name: Skill-MAP-Elites
papers.title: Skill-MAP-Elites: Open-Ended Evolution of Agent Skills through Behavioral Niches
papers.summary: Formulates skill evolution as quality-diversity search, assigning executed candidates to behavioral niches (failure-type coverage, tool-call structure, cost, robustness, cross-model gains) and keeping local elites, with behavior-level mutations and uncertainty-aware admission.
papers.summary_zh: 把 skill 进化表述为质量—多样性搜索：按失败类型覆盖、工具调用结构、成本、鲁棒性和跨模型增益等行为特征把执行过的候选划入生态位并保留各自的精英，配合行为层面的变异和考虑不确定性的准入。

papers.name: BioSkill-Evolver
papers.title: Verifier-Guided Skill Evolution for Autonomous Spatial Omics Analysis
papers.summary: Stores spatial-omics analysis capabilities as executable skills with explicit pre- and postconditions and uses a multi-granularity verifier as the reward that drives rewriting failing skills and splitting high-variance skills into platform-specific variants.
papers.summary_zh: 把空间组学分析能力存为带显式前置和后置条件的可执行 skill，以多粒度验证器作为奖励，驱动重写失败的 skill，并把方差大的 skill 拆成针对不同平台的变体。

papers.name: TriEvo
papers.title: TriEvo: Three-Agent Evolution of Policies and Optimizers
papers.summary: A three-agent setup in which a supervisor revises the evolver's instructions from cumulative development evidence while the evolver improves a frozen-weight agent's prompt, skill, and memory, with gated comparisons to test whether an optimizer revision is worth retaining.
papers.summary_zh: 三 agent 设置：进化器改进冻结权重 agent 的提示、skill 和记忆，监督者依据累积的开发证据修订进化器的指令，并用带门控的对比检验这种优化器修订是否值得保留。

papers.name: Skill Cleanliness
papers.title: Skill Cleanliness: Diagnosing and Restoring Execution Recoverability in Agent Skills
papers.summary: Defines skill uncleanliness as organizational barriers that keep correct knowledge from being extracted or executed by a given executor, scores it with a skill cleanliness score that localizes defects, and repairs skills through verified restoration grounded in source evidence.
papers.summary_zh: 把“skill 不整洁”定义为让特定执行模型难以提取或执行其中正确知识的组织性障碍，用 skill 整洁度分数评估并定位缺陷，再通过有来源依据、经验证的修复来改写 skill。

papers.name: Learning to Repair
papers.title: Learning to Repair: Skill Optimization for Multi-Round Text-to-Image Generation
papers.summary: Optimizes the critic's natural-language skill for multi-round text-to-image generation, structured around failure diagnosis, type-conditional repair actions, preservation requirements, and repair order, refining it from historical trajectories while the models stay frozen.
papers.summary_zh: 为多轮文生图中的评审模型优化其自然语言 skill，内容按失败诊断、按类型选择修复动作、保留要求和修复顺序组织，基于历史轨迹打磨，模型本身保持冻结。

papers.name: TailSkills
papers.title: Focused but Fragile: Diagnosing Tail-Rule Loss under Recursive Agent Skill Compression
papers.summary: A controlled benchmark of task variants paired with exception-triggering environments that shows recursive, artifact-only skill compression keeps routine workflow instructions more reliably than rare exception-recovery rules.
papers.summary_zh: 一个受控基准，每个任务变体都配有触发异常的环境；结果显示在只看前一版工件的递归压缩下，skill 对常规流程指令的保留明显好于对罕见异常恢复规则的保留。

papers.name: SkillSeg
papers.title: SkillSeg: Self-Evolving Agent Skills via Feedback Attribution
papers.summary: Attributes feedback to individual skills over trajectory segments run under the same active skill by contrasting action likelihoods with and without that skill, combined with the episode outcome against a historical baseline, and gates library updates with a likelihood ratio.
papers.summary_zh: 在同一活跃 skill 下执行的轨迹片段上，对比有无该 skill 时动作的似然，并结合回合结果相对历史基线的高低，把反馈归因到具体 skill，再用似然比门控 skill 库的更新。

papers.name: SLIM
papers.title: Dynamic Skill Lifecycle Management for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: Dynamic skill lifecycle management during agentic RL: estimates each active skill's marginal contribution by leave-one-skill-out validation and retains, retires, or expands the external skill set as the policy learns.
papers.summary_zh: 在 agent 强化学习过程中动态管理 skill 生命周期：用留一 skill 验证估计每个活跃 skill 的边际贡献，随策略学习保留、退役或扩充外部 skill 集合。

papers.name: SkillCertainty
papers.title: SkillCertainty: Uncertainty Quantification for Self-evolving Agent Skills
papers.summary: Uses step-level conformal prediction against behavioral references from successful trajectories to decide whether an execution supports direct skill distillation or triggers targeted revision, and conditions skill generation on the localized deviations.
papers.summary_zh: 以成功轨迹构建行为参照，用步骤级保形预测判断一次执行是支持直接提炼 skill 还是需要针对性修订，并把定位到的偏离作为 skill 生成的条件。

papers.name: SD-BoN
papers.title: Beyond Sampling More: Scaling LLM Agents through Skill-Conditioned Exploration
papers.summary: Uses reusable skills as a source of structured exploration for test-time scaling: selects several skills from a large open-source pool by a relevance–diversity criterion and allocates rollouts across them before majority voting, and analyzes breadth across skills versus depth within one.
papers.summary_zh: 把可复用 skill 作为测试时扩展的结构化探索来源：从大型开源 skill 池中按相关性与多样性选出多个 skill，把采样预算分配给它们后多数投票，并分析跨 skill 的广度与单个 skill 内深度的取舍。

papers.name: DivSkill-SQL
papers.title: Residual Skill Optimization for Text-to-SQL Ensembles
papers.summary: Builds complementary agentic Text-to-SQL ensembles without fine-tuning by optimizing each new skill on the examples the current skill ensemble fails, targeting its marginal contribution to Pass@K.
papers.summary_zh: 无需微调地构建互补的 agent 式 Text-to-SQL 集成：每个新 skill 都在当前 skill 集成失败的样本上优化，以其对 Pass@K 的边际贡献为目标。

papers.name: MetaClaw
papers.title: MetaClaw: Just Talk -- An Agent That Meta-Learns and Evolves in the Wild
papers.summary: A continual meta-learning framework for deployed agents that synthesizes new skills from failure trajectories for immediate adaptation and runs gradient-based RL updates of the policy during user-inactive windows, keeping data for skill evolution and RL separate.
papers.summary_zh: 面向已部署 agent 的持续元学习框架：从失败轨迹即时合成新 skill 实现快速适应，并在用户空闲时段对策略做基于梯度的强化学习更新，同时把用于 skill 进化与用于 RL 的数据分开。

papers.name: SkillSandbox
papers.title: SkillSandbox: Dynamic Scenario Synthesis for Agent Skill Verification
papers.summary: Verifies whether a distilled skill is reusable beyond its source experience by synthesizing a skill-relevant but novel task and environment for it, then comparing executions with and without the skill to decide whether it enters the library.
papers.summary_zh: 为检验提炼出的 skill 能否在来源经验之外复用，为每个 skill 合成与其相关但新的任务和环境，比较有无该 skill 的执行结果，决定它是否进入 skill 库。

papers.name: TARO
papers.title: From Failure to Foresight: Temporal Anticipatory Reflective Optimization for Skill Learning in Agents
papers.summary: An RL framework that trains a skill generator to anticipate downstream execution dynamics instead of correcting skills only after failures, flattening temporally refined skill variants into counterfactual groups for GRPO updates.
papers.summary_zh: 一个强化学习框架，训练 skill 生成器预判后续执行走向，而不是在失败后才修正 skill；把随时间打磨的 skill 变体整理成反事实组，用于 GRPO 更新。
